def call(mt, msg, tools=True):

       "messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are an AI agent. Use tools."},{"role":"user","content":msg}],

        headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {K}","Content-Type":"application/json"})

    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: return f"HTTP{e.code}", e.read().decode()[:80], None, {}
